rca_of_the_issue.bug: Frontend crashes on all pages with React Three Fiber error
rca_of_the_issue.root_cause: App.js imports @react-three/fiber components (Dashboard3D, SmartEngine3D) at module level. React 19 introduced breaking changes to internal APIs that react-three-fiber 8.x depends on. The library tries to access ReactCurrentOwner which is undefined in React 19.
reproduction_steps: 3. Error: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'ReactCurrentOwner')
mitigation: Option 2: Change App.js imports to use React.lazy() for Dashboard3D and SmartEngine3D
Option 3: Downgrade React to v18 (not recommended)
